'''JohnsonJedi Royal Guards Strike Back''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[JohnsonJedi]]
* '''Published:''' 10 May 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Theme/Fun
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Death Star II: Throne Room|DS2-D-deathstariithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Death Star II: Throne Room
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 DS2TR JohnsonJedi DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Royal guards have never been a major part of any deck thus they never showed their true potential, until now!

== Strategy ==

Pretty much I just get as many royal guards armed with force pikes that I can and draw a lot of battle destiny hopefully destroying my opponent.
